announcements.msg: StarGaze Vip Proxy (No Root) is LIVE — green channel, main ID safe on India server. 2.1 stays yellow: second ID only.

versions.name: StarGaze Vip Proxy (No Root)
versions.desc: Proxy injection panel for Free Fire — no root needed. Aim Silent + Chams Location. Main ID fully safe on the India server.
notes: Main ID fully safe · India server only
FIRST open Free Fire and log in to your ID
If any function does not work, reinject several times
steps: Install Shizuku (Play Store or GitHub) on the phone
Enable Developer Options: tap Build Number 7 times in About phone
In Developer Options enable Wireless Debugging
Open Shizuku → Pairing → Wireless Debugging Pairing → enter the code Android shows
Tap Start in Shizuku to launch the service
Open StarGaze Vip Proxy and allow the Shizuku permission prompt
First run: open Free Fire and log in to your ID before injecting
Start the proxy — if a function does not work, reinject several times
Second account? Repeat the exact same Shizuku setup steps on that device

versions.name: STARGAZE Mods_Proxy 2.1 (No Root)
versions.desc: Full power proxy panel — no root. Full aim-bot and all ESP modules for Free Fire.
notes: Use second ID on this build
steps: Set up Shizuku once: install app → Wireless Debugging → pair with the on-screen code → Start
Open STARGAZE Mods_Proxy 2.1 and grant the Shizuku permission
Get your key from @Kurama_GetKey_bot on Telegram
Enter the key in the panel
Open Free Fire, log in to your SECOND ID, then inject
Reinject several times if anything does not attach

versions.name: Kuruma Panel 3.7.1-STABLE (Root)
versions.desc: Classic rooted executive build. Memory pointer hooks, full ESP pipeline, anomaly shield. arm64-v8a, Magisk/KernelSU.
steps: Download the APK directly from this page
Allow installs from unknown apps; Play Protect may scan the packed file once
Grant Magisk/KernelSU superuser when asked
Enable Display over other apps for the overlay
Activate your license key and wait for OK
Launch the floating panel inside a match

versions.name: Kuruma Panel 2.58.3-LEGACY (Root)
versions.desc: Older stable line. Still attaches cleanly, detection heat higher — second account strongly advised.

versions.name: Kuruma Panel 2.40.0-PATCHED (Root)
versions.desc: Server-side patched. Installs but hooks never attach; kept for archive only.
